materials.purpose: Approved stylized materials reused on fixed wireframe faces; prepared offline.
rules: Use this exact approved source atlas and crop recipe by default.
No independent palette generation per orientation.
Preserve geometry, silhouettes, joints, anchors and projection.
Use the same material identity on a stone top and its upper facade.
Broad painted facets, sparse graphic wear and localized violet accents; no realistic grain or bark.
Godot selects finished PNGs with white modulation; no runtime appearance repair.
